paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: The pie chart represents the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which covers 12 distinct domains. The chart consists of 12 slices, each labeled with a specific domain and corresponding percentage. The domains and their respective percentages are as follows: AI/NLP Research, blue, 24.3%; Business, red, 5.9%; Geography, orange, 2.7%; Math, yellow, 1.2%; Game&Anime, green, 8.2%; Econ. & Fin., light blue, 18.4%; Science, light blue, 6.7%; Law, pink, 5.1%; History, yellow, 8.2%; Med & Health, green, 6.7%; Pet & Animal, orange, 5.5%; and Daily Life, teal, 7.1%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, but no specific pattern is evident. A legend is not present, but the labels and colors are clearly associated with each slice. No slices are visually emphasized.
